012965:     function sortVehicleCheckboxesByBestArrival(matches) {
012966:         const getMetrics = input => {
012967:             const now = Date.now();
012968:             const cached = mfVehicleArrivalMetricCache.get(input);
012969: 
012970:             if (cached && now < cached.expiresAt) {
012971:                 return cached;
012972:             }
012973: 
012974:             const row = input?.closest?.('tr');
012975:             const metrics = {
012976:                 delay: parseFloat(
012977:                     row?.getAttribute('data-sortvalue') ||
012978:                     row?.getAttribute('timevalue') ||
012979:                     '999999'
012980:                 ),
012981:                 distance: parseFloat(
012982:                     row?.getAttribute('data-distance') ||
012983:                     '999999'
012984:                 ),
012985:                 expiresAt: now + 500
012986:             };
012987: 
012988:             mfVehicleArrivalMetricCache.set(input, metrics);
012989:             return metrics;
012990:         };
012991: 
012992:         matches.sort((a, b) => {
012993:             const metricsA = getMetrics(a);
012994:             const metricsB = getMetrics(b);
012995:             return (
012996:                 metricsA.delay - metricsB.delay ||
012997:                 metricsA.distance - metricsB.distance
012998:             );
012999:         });
013000: 
013001:         return matches;
013002:     }

035111:     function realClickForQueueRestart(element) {
035112:         if (!element) return false;
035113: 
035114:         try {
035115:             element.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', inline: 'center' });
035116:         } catch (error) {}
035117: 
035118:         try {
035119:             element.focus && element.focus({ preventScroll: true });
035120:         } catch (error) {}
035121: 
035122:         // One native click only.
035123:         // Sending several synthetic click sequences opened duplicate MissionChief modals.
035124:         try {
035125:             if (typeof element.click === 'function') {
035126:                 element.click();
035127:                 return true;
035128:             }
035129:         } catch (error) {}
035130: 
035131:         // Final fallback only when native click is unavailable.
035132:         try {
035133:             element.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {
035134:                 bubbles: true,
035135:                 cancelable: true,
035136:                 composed: true,
035137:                 view: element.ownerDocument?.defaultView || window
035138:             }));
035139:             return true;
035140:         } catch (error) {
035141:             return false;
035142:         }
035143:     }

035111:     function realClickForQueueRestart(element) {
035112:         if (!element) return false;
035113: 
035114:         try {
035115:             element.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', inline: 'center' });
035116:         } catch (error) {}
035117: 
035118:         try {
035119:             element.focus && element.focus({ preventScroll: true });
035120:         } catch (error) {}
035121: 
035122:         // One native click only.
035123:         // Sending several synthetic click sequences opened duplicate MissionChief modals.
035124:         try {
035125:             if (typeof element.click === 'function') {
035126:                 element.click();
035127:                 return true;
035128:             }
035129:         } catch (error) {}
035130: 
035131:         // Final fallback only when native click is unavailable.
035132:         try {
035133:             element.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {
035134:                 bubbles: true,
035135:                 cancelable: true,
035136:                 composed: true,
035137:                 view: element.ownerDocument?.defaultView || window
035138:             }));
035139:             return true;
035140:         } catch (error) {
035141:             return false;
035142:         }

011738:         ]

012965:     function sortVehicleCheckboxesByBestArrival(matches) {
012966:         const getMetrics = input => {
012967:             const now = Date.now();
012968:             const cached = mfVehicleArrivalMetricCache.get(input);
012969: 
012970:             if (cached && now < cached.expiresAt) {
012971:                 return cached;
012972:             }
012973: 
012974:             const row = input?.closest?.('tr');
012975:             const metrics = {
012976:                 delay: parseFloat(
012977:                     row?.getAttribute('data-sortvalue') ||
012978:                     row?.getAttribute('timevalue') ||
012979:                     '999999'
012980:                 ),
012981:                 distance: parseFloat(
012982:                     row?.getAttribute('data-distance') ||
012983:                     '999999'
012984:                 ),
012985:                 expiresAt: now + 500
012986:             };
012987: 
012988:             mfVehicleArrivalMetricCache.set(input, metrics);
012989:             return metrics;
012990:         };

012993:             const metricsA = getMetrics(a);
012994:             const metricsB = getMetrics(b);

012996:                 metricsA.delay - metricsB.delay ||
012997:                 metricsA.distance - metricsB.distance
012998:             );
012999:         });

017250:     function addOrUpdateVehicleRow(originalName, mappedName, required, status, selected) {
017251:         const safeRequired = Math.max(0, parseInt(required, 10) || 0);
017252:         const safeSelected = Number.isFinite(Number(selected)) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(Number(selected), safeRequired)) : countSelectedMatchingVehicles(originalName, mappedName);
017253:         const existing = vehicleLoadState.rows.find(row => row.originalName === originalName && row.mappedName === mappedName);
017254: 
017255:         if (existing) {
017256:             existing.mappedName = mappedName;
017257:             existing.required = safeRequired;
017258:             existing.selected = Math.min(safeSelected, safeRequired);
017259:             existing.status = status || (existing.selected >= safeRequired ? 'assigned' : existing.selected > 0 ? 'retrying' : 'pending');
017260:             return;
017261:         }
017262: 
017263:         vehicleLoadState.rows.push({
017264:             originalName,
017265:             mappedName,
017266:             required: safeRequired,
017267:             selected: Math.min(safeSelected, safeRequired),
017268:             status: status || (safeSelected >= safeRequired ? 'assigned' : safeSelected > 0 ? 'retrying' : 'pending')
017269:         });
017270:     }

023477:         registry
023478:     ) {

023482:                 : [];

023484:         const arrivalIndex =
023485:             new Map(
023486:                 source.map((checkbox, index) => [
023487:                     checkbox,
023488:                     index
023489:                 ])
023490:             );
023491: 
023492:         const checked =
023493:             source.filter(checkbox => checkbox.checked);
023494: 
023495:         const unchecked =
023496:             source.filter(checkbox => !checkbox.checked);
023497: 
023498:         const hinted =
023499:             unchecked
023500:                 .map(checkbox => {
023501:                     const registryMatch =
023502:                         getRegistryEntryForMissionCheckbox(
023503:                             checkbox,
023504:                             registry
023505:                         );
023506: 
023507:                     return {
023508:                         checkbox,
023509:                         score:
023510:                             getUnverifiedRegistryTrainingHintScore(
023511:                                 requirements,
023512:                                 registryMatch.entry
023513:                             )
023514:                     };
023515:                 })
023516:                 .filter(item => item.score > 0)
023517:                 .sort((left, right) => {
023518:                     if (left.score !== right.score) {
023519:                         return right.score - left.score;
023520:                     }
023521: 
023522:                     return (
023523:                         arrivalIndex.get(left.checkbox) -
023524:                         arrivalIndex.get(right.checkbox)
023525:                     );
023526:                 })
023527:                 .map(item => item.checkbox);
023528: 
023529:         const hintedSet = new Set(hinted);
023530: 
023531:         const remaining =
023532:             unchecked.filter(
023533:                 checkbox => !hintedSet.has(checkbox)
023534:             );
023535: 
023536:         return [
023537:             ...checked,
023538:             ...hinted,
023539:             ...remaining
023540:         ].filter((checkbox, index, array) => {
023541:             return array.indexOf(checkbox) === index;
023542:         });
023543:     }

024107:

024113:                 getVehicleCheckboxSnapshot().filter(checkbox => {
024114:                     return !!(
024115:                         (!checkbox.disabled || checkbox.checked) &&
024116:                         isPoliceCarVehicleCheckbox(checkbox)
024117:                     );
024118:                 })

024127:                 getRegistryEntryForMissionCheckbox(
024128:                     checkbox,
024129:                     registry
024130:                 );
024131:

024133:                 isKnownProtectedTrainedPoliceIrvEntry(
024134:                     registryMatch.entry

024136:             ) {

024147:                 return;
024148:             }
024149: 
024150:             unknownOrStaleVehicles += 1;

024162:             );
024163:         }

024167:             pagesRead: 0,

024087:     async function refreshOrdinaryPoliceRegistryFromLiveVehicles(
024088:         rows,
024089:         source = 'UPDATE'
024090:     ) {
024091:         const ordinaryVehiclesRequired =
024092:             getOrdinaryPoliceVehicleRequirementCount(
024093:                 rows
024094:             );
024095: 
024096:         if (ordinaryVehiclesRequired <= 0) {
024097:             return {
024098:                 refreshed: false,
024099:                 pagesRead: 0,
024100:                 verifiedOrdinaryVehicles: 0,
024101:                 unknownOrStaleVehicles: 0,
024102:                 protectedFallbackVehicles: 0,
024103:                 availablePoliceCars: 0,
024104:                 required: 0
024105:             };
024106:         }
024107: 
024108:         const registry =
024109:             readPersonnelTrainingRegistry();
024110: 
024111:         const candidates =
024112:             sortVehicleCheckboxesByBestArrival(
024113:                 getVehicleCheckboxSnapshot().filter(checkbox => {
024114:                     return !!(
024115:                         (!checkbox.disabled || checkbox.checked) &&
024116:                         isPoliceCarVehicleCheckbox(checkbox)
024117:                     );
024118:                 })
024119:             );
024120: 
024121:         let verifiedOrdinaryVehicles = 0;
024122:         let unknownOrStaleVehicles = 0;
024123:         let protectedFallbackVehicles = 0;
024124: 
024125:         candidates.forEach(checkbox => {
024126:             const registryMatch =
024127:                 getRegistryEntryForMissionCheckbox(
024128:                     checkbox,
024129:                     registry
024130:                 );
024131: 
024132:             if (
024133:                 isKnownProtectedTrainedPoliceIrvEntry(
024134:                     registryMatch.entry
024135:                 )
024136:             ) {
024137:                 protectedFallbackVehicles += 1;
024138:                 return;
024139:             }
024140: 
024141:             if (
024142:                 isVerifiedOrdinaryPoliceIrvEntry(
024143:                     registryMatch.entry
024144:                 )
024145:             ) {
024146:                 verifiedOrdinaryVehicles += 1;
024147:                 return;
024148:             }
024149: 
024150:             unknownOrStaleVehicles += 1;
024151:         });
024152: 
024153:         // Generic Police attendance does not require a qualification check.
024154:         // The registry is therefore an ordering hint only. Avoid reading every
024155:         // /zuweisung page before selection: ordinary vehicles remain first,
024156:         // unknown/stale vehicles remain usable, and known specialists are a
024157:         // final fallback when no normal pool can satisfy the mission.
024158:         if (mfDebugEnabled) {
024159:             debugLog(
024160:                 'POLICE CAR POOL',
024161:                 `${source} | required=${ordinaryVehiclesRequired} | ordinary=${verifiedOrdinaryVehicles} | unknown/stale=${unknownOrStaleVehicles} | specialist fallback=${protectedFallbackVehicles} | total=${candidates.length}`
024162:             );
024163:         }
024164: 
024165:         return {
024166:             refreshed: false,
024167:             pagesRead: 0,
024168:             verifiedOrdinaryVehicles,
024169:             unknownOrStaleVehicles,
024170:             protectedFallbackVehicles,
024171:             availablePoliceCars:
024172:                 candidates.length,
024173:             required:
024174:                 ordinaryVehiclesRequired
024175:         };
024176:     }
